summary: Implemented the progress file-reading feature in rich/progress.py (module-level open and wrap_file, Progress.open and Progress.wrap_file, private _ProgressReader and _ReaderContext), added 19 tests to tests/test_progress.py, documented it in docs/source/progress.rst, and added a CHANGELOG.md entry for PR 1759. Nothing was run (no tests, mypy, or black), and nothing was committed. Open concerns: on Python 3.6, typing.IO's abstract name/mode properties may make _ProgressReader uninstantiable, which needs a decision since the spec forbids adding them; suppression codes are unverified without mypy; and Progress.open leaves an orphaned task if the file open fails after the task is added, per the spec's step order.
